principles: Small treats are fine; the aim is to choose them, not drift into them.
Pick the ones you would miss most and let the rest go.
Look at the month's total, not the single purchase.

gentle.title: Little treats add up
gentle.body: Coffee, takeaways and eating out came to {everyday_spend_last_month} last month. None of it is wrong, but it is worth deciding which of those you really enjoy and which just happened.

blunt.title: Everyday spending is {everyday_spend_last_month} a month
blunt.body: You spent {everyday_spend_last_month} on coffee, takeaways and eating out last month. Pick the ones you would actually miss and cut the rest this week.
